rows.graphmap_boundary: GraphMap uses Copy + Ord + Hash node weights as keys and does not allow parallel edges, so it does not carry the complete projection multigraph.
rows.intersection_reason: Graph has compact indices suited to a temporary intersection graph built once and read without removals; removal can move the last node or edge into the vacated slot.
rows.name: petgraph
rows.projection_reason: StableGraph preserves unrelated node and edge indices on removal and supports parallel edges; a removed slot is not a permanent identity and may be reused.
